summary: Version 0.16.0 is live: antipo.watch shows a clean login page; every page (scanner, portfolio, IPO page, dossier) answers only after signing in, on antipo.watch and on the Fly.io address, checked from outside. The owner's account (chosen by the owner in the chat) and the upload token are in the machine's secrets, typed in hidden prompts. Results live on the server only: the Nov 20 signals and decisions were uploaded through the new endpoint (checked by the same rules) and removed from the repository, which now ignores result files. The daily run uploads instead of pushing. VISION.md: signals are private to the owner.
delivered: auth.py: account, signed session cookie (30 days), slowed wrong logins, bearer token.
login.html.j2 and its style; /login, /logout; the gate on every route but /login, /static, /health and the upload endpoint.
PUT /api/upload/<signals|decisions|ledger>/<name>, checked then stored in /data/results; the scanner reads /data/results.
python -m ipo_monitor.scan upload; ROUTINE.md step 9; the session cron prompt updated.
tests/test_auth.py; e2e sign-in on a phone.
VISION, DECISIONS D-052, CHANGELOG 0.16.0, INFRASTRUCTURE, README, .env.example, .gitignore.
